name: bouquet_toss
description: Fourteen frames at 10 fps as the bouquet leaves her hand.
why: One press of the shutter, one thing that happened. A photographer asked to group these would not hesitate: this is the shot, and thirteen of the fourteen frames exist so that one of them can be chosen. Splitting it anywhere would mean claiming the bouquet was thrown twice.
labelled_by: PHASE-08 section 8 step 9, authored ground truth
